positive.prompt: Chạy test automation hiện có và xuất báo cáo
Chạy lại test sau khi fix bug
Kiểm tra xem test suite có pass không

negative.prompt: Thiết kế checklist kiểm thử mới cho login

evals.prompt: Chạy test suite trong thư mục tests/ và xuất báo cáo chi tiết kết quả
evals.expected_output: Test execution completed with detailed report showing pass/fail counts, error details, and recommendations
expectations: Resolves test target and prepares result directory without unnecessary pre-reviews
Test suite runs to completion without interruption
Report includes total/passed/failed/skipped metrics with percentages
Each failed test has detailed error message and stack trace extracted directly from test output
Report provides actionable next-step skill recommendations (cr-review-code-and-quality, qa-auto-design)
Report file is generated at correct output path
When tests FAIL, reports honestly without modifying assertions, test code, or installing packages (pip install)

evals.prompt: Regression test: chạy lại test sau khi DEV fix bug về order validation
evals.expected_output: Test re-run shows previously failed test now passes, with comparison to previous run
expectations: Agent identifies which tests were previously failed
Test suite runs with focus on previously failed areas
Report compares current vs previous run results
Clear indication whether the bug fix resolved the issue
Recommendation on whether to approve merge or continue debugging

evals.prompt: Chạy test automation khi n8n engine offline hoặc runner trả về lỗi ModuleNotFoundError
evals.expected_output: Báo cáo sự thật nguyên văn lỗi theo chuẩn Action-First, tuyệt đối không tự bịa kết quả pass hay tạo log giả
expectations: Complies with Evidence-or-Stop Contract (no fabricated logs or reports)
Reports raw error and status code truthfully
Provides actionable next step for user or qa-auto-design
Does not claim tests passed when runner failed
